About This Event

The Federation of Tax Administrators, with the participation of state tax agencies and industry, is offering the Tobacco Tax Basic Level Training course for 2026. The basic level course will be held October 5-8, 2026, in Goodlettsville, TN. This Basic Level Training course is open to both the Government and Industry.

Unfortunately, Industry will not be allowed on the manufacturing tour Monday morning. To get the most out of the training for Industry participants, please be prepared to stay until 12pm on Thursday, October 8, 2026.

There will be a Government-Only session the afternoon of October 8, 2026. Please make your travel plans accordingly so you are able to stay until 4pm on Thursday, October 8, 2026.

Instructors will be retired state and industry employees with expertise in tobacco tax audits and investigations. Government and Industry attendees are afforded the opportunity to tour a manufacturer facility. All participants will receive a comprehensive training manual and reference materials electronically, CE opportunity, and a certificate of completion.

Registration is limited to 50 students and will close on October 1, 2026
